newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen. Lott says budget talks continue.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen. Lott says budget talks continue.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Friday talks were continuing with the White House on details of the week-old budget agreement, but warned Congress needs flexibility to modify the plan as the tax and spending bills work their way to final passage.
"There are no rulers in the Senate," he said as he explained that the leaders of various committees retain considerable influence over the final budget product.
The House and Senate Budget Committees are to hold public meetings on the five-year budget deal next week, but separate tax and spending bill needed to enact it are months away.
